metrics.label: Line of Credit (TTEC)
metrics.note: TTEC's only debt line: 'Line of credit' (us-gaap:LongTermLineOfCredit) under long-term liabilities -- $905 million at FY2025, $975 million at FY2024, $995 million at FY2023. Binding-owned intermediate: the operand the current_debt zeroing below reads.

metrics.label: Long-Term Debt
metrics.note: The same 'Line of credit' line. TTEC's debt is a single revolving credit facility; the shared vocabulary cannot reach it on the analyze page because us-gaap:LongTermLineOfCredit is a screen-only component there.

metrics.label: Total Debt
metrics.note: Bound directly to the combined line, which already contains the whole borrowing. TTEC's balance sheet carries no current portion of debt, so the total equals the line-of-credit carrying amount.

metrics.label: Current Debt
metrics.note: Zero, deliberately. TTEC's balance sheet carries no current portion of debt.

note: Debt, scoped to this filer. TTEC Holdings' only debt is its revolving credit facility, carried as a single 'Line of credit' line (us-gaap:LongTermLineOfCredit, $905M at FY2025) under long-term liabilities, with no current portion.
